## Notes on extraction discipline

- Each intent binds the narrowest contiguous segment range that fully contains every named actor, action, date, quantity, attribution, qualifier, and outcome in the claim. No detail is included that is supported only by adjacent or remembered text.
- D0004 and D0005 are split because the two cited Decrees (DOF 27 Dec 2016 vs DOF 4 Mar 2022) are named in non-contiguous segments (S00008 and S00009); splitting avoids non-contiguous support within one intent.
- D0001 spans S00007–S00009 to keep the issuing officer and both Decree citations together; if a reviewer prefers splitting, D0001 splits cleanly into actor (S00007), 2016-Decree basis (S00008), and 2022-Decree basis (S00009).
- No quotation text is reproduced in any semantic field. Numeric values (percentages, pesos/liter, dates) are restated from the segments in the claim narrative and are reproducible from the cited range.
- Period fit is anchored to the Acuerdo's own applicable period (10–16 December 2022) and to its signing date (8 December 2022), not to any external ruler-period assumption.
